title: Munda
provider: Multiling Cloud / Government of Bangladesh language portal
scope: Bangladesh Munda/Mundari linguistic heritage and digital archive

provider_metadata_verified.project_label: Enhancement of Bengali Language in ICT Through Research and Development (EBLICT)

canonicalization.rule: Portal landing page, archive views and item pages are manifestations/components of one provider archive; individual recordings become separate source objects only after stable item identity and locator verification.

evidence_conversion.reason: Landing-page metadata is sufficient for source discovery and conversion planning, but item-level stable identity, audio/transcript locators, licence/reuse terms, contributor consent and cultural-access scope were not verified in this run.

conversion_queue: enumerate stable archive item identifiers without assuming the displayed aggregate count is a release count
verify licence/reuse terms and speaker/contributor consent scope
preserve provider transcription exactly and record language/script labels
create item-level time/text locators only after direct inspection
separate elicited/directed material from spontaneous/community material
apply cultural-access and dignity review before public exposure
deduplicate against Karya/MunTTS and other speech corpora by item/hash/provenance rather than title
uncertainty: The portal landing page currently displays 860 for Full Archive while topic/speaker/sentence/minute summary fields display zero; these interface values are not interpreted as validated corpus statistics.
No cultural claim is inferred from the portal's general linguistic-heritage prose.
No assumption is made that Bangladesh Munda material represents Jharkhand/India Mundari varieties.
release_effect: discovery audit only; controlled MMSC/evidence/module counts remain frozen pending deterministic reconciliation
